scripts.text:
[New Agent]
You have too many items. Please make room in your inventory and come back.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
您的物品栏已满。请整理出空位后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
Wow~ Finally!! It's the season we've all been waiting for!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
哇~终于到了！我们所有人都期待已久的季节来了！

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
It's RWC time!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
RWC就要开始啦！

scripts.text: What is RWC?
scripts.translation: 什么是RWC？

scripts.text: Are you a New Agent?
scripts.translation: 你是新特工吗？

scripts.text: I don't care.
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
You must be a new adventurer. I will kindly explain it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
你一定是刚开始冒险吧。
我来给你介绍一下。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
It seems you've traveled quite enough but you're not good with hearing the news around the world.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
看来你游历了不少地方，但似乎不太关注世界各地的新闻。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
There are few adventurers in Midgard whose lives are dedicated to battle, who never skip their training, live in seclusion, and are experts in their art.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
米德加尔特有一些冒险者，一生都在追求战斗的极致。
他们隐居修行，从不间断训练，个个身怀绝技。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
The RWC is the festival where those adventurers can compete with each other and find out who is the best!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
RWC就是让这些冒险者同场竞技，决出最强者的盛会！

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
But this cannot be achieved all alone. Your friends will have a huge role in the competition.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
不过，单打独斗可不行。
你的朋友们在比赛中也会发挥重要作用。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
If you're interested in this festival, start looking for friends you can trust!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
如果你对这场盛会感兴趣，就开始寻找值得信赖的伙伴吧！

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
Many events are organized for RWC promotion every year.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
每年都会举办许多活动来宣传RWC。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
And this year, a special mission has been entrusted to a new agent... myself!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
今年，一项特殊任务交给了一位新特工...也就是我！

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
I am supposed to attach blue cards with the letters RWC2011 all over the world to promote the event. But... but...
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
我需要在世界各地贴上印有RWC2011字样的蓝色卡片来宣传活动。但是...但是...

scripts.text: - He thought of something and then looked at your eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎想到了什么，抬眼望着你。 -

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
Would you like to listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
你想听听我的故事吗？

scripts.text: Sure, let me hear it.
scripts.translation: 当然，请说

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
Arrgg!! Are you ignoring me because I'm new? Usually people listen...
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
啊！！就因为我是新来的，你才不理我吗？别人一般都会听我说的...

scripts.text: - New Agent is looking at you with pitiable eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 新特工正用可怜的眼神看着你。 -

scripts.text: - His brimming small eyes seem to tell you something. ^FF0000Please talk to me again...^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 他那双水汪汪的小眼睛似乎在诉说着什么。^FF0000请再和我谈谈...^000000 -

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
This is my first mission but people's reaction is not good.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
这是我的第一次任务，但人们的反应并不好。

scripts.text: - New Agent is looking at you with pitiable eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 新特工正用可怜的眼神看着你。 -

scripts.text: - His twinkling small eyes seem to tell you something. ^FF0000Please talk to me again...^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 他那双闪烁的小眼睛似乎在诉说着什么。^FF0000请再和我谈谈...^000000 -

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
I used to be a very normal boy in Morocc.
I am not an adventurer and I don't even know how to buy/sell things. Sometimes I'm just very happy to see adventurers. You know... I am just an ordinary boy.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
我以前只是梦罗克的一个普通男孩。
我不是冒险者，连买卖东西都不会。
有时候，光是看见冒险者就很开心了。
你知道的...我只是个普通男孩。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
People used to tell me that since I was very shy.
I would spend my life in a suburb.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
以前大家总说，我这么害羞，大概一辈子都会待在郊区。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
But eventually, my patience and restrained personality motivated me to become an agent for RWC2011!
I was so happy that I couldn't sleep! I would finally have a chance to meet lots of adventurers and get to know them.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
不过，我凭着耐心和沉稳的性格，终于成为了RWC2011的特工！
当时我高兴得睡不着觉！
终于有机会认识许多冒险者了。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
This mission was so important to me,
I was afraid of being attacked by monsters when attaching the blue cards for RWC2011 in the streets.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
这次任务对我来说非常重要。
可一想到要在街上张贴RWC2011的蓝色卡片，我就怕遇上魔物袭击。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
......

[New Agent]
And you know what?
^FF0000It really happened!^000000
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
你猜怎么着？
^FF0000真的发生了！^000000

scripts.text: Are you serious!?
scripts.translation: 你是认真的吗！？

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
I had turned off the light and was trying to get some sleep, then I saw this bright light through the window.
Suddenly, the window was broken and it appeared!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
我关了灯，正准备睡觉，忽然看到窗外闪过一道亮光。
接着，窗户突然被打破，它就出现了！

scripts.text: It?
scripts.translation: 它？

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
It was a shining poring! And it ate all blue cards I had prepared in less than a second!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
那是一只闪闪发光的波利！它在不到一秒内吃掉了我准备的所有蓝色卡片！

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
I was so shocked, I tried to calm down and think... I had neither heard about nor seen any shining poring!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
我吓坏了，努力让自己冷静下来想一想...
我从来没听说过，更没见过会发光的波利！

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
^FF0000Yes! It must be a dream!^000000 That's the conclusion I came up with and went back to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
^FF0000对！一定是在做梦！^000000
这么一想，我就又睡过去了。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
But it wasn't a dream. When I woke up, I realized all the blue cards were gone...
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
可那并不是梦。
醒来后，我发现蓝色卡片全都不见了...

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
If I ruin this promotion, I might lose the job and have to go back to where I used to live alone...
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
要是搞砸这次宣传，我可能会丢掉工作，又得回到原来的地方独自生活...

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
If you see the Golden Poring, could you please find the precious blue cards for me?
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
如果你看到黄金波利，能请你帮我找回那些珍贵的蓝色卡片吗？

scripts.text: - He looks at you with imploring eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 他用恳求的眼神看着你。 -

scripts.text: Ok, I will help you!
scripts.translation: 好的，我会帮你的！

scripts.text: How much money can you offer me?
scripts.translation: 你能给我多少报酬？

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
Have you decided to help me? Well, I will prepare some gifts. I'm sure you'll like them.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
你决定帮我了吗？
那我会准备一些礼物，相信你一定会喜欢。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
What you are looking for are large cards with the letters ^FF0000RWC2011^000000. Some of them might already be digested though.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
要找的是印着^FF0000RWC2011^000000字样的大卡片。
不过，有些可能已经被消化掉了。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
Try to gather remaining cards until you make the word, 'RWC2011'.
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
收集剩下的卡片，直到能拼出“RWC2011”为止。

scripts.text:
[New Agent]
Please help me out!! My life is in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[新特工]
请帮帮我！！我的命就掌握在你手里了！

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
Have you gathered all the cards?
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
你收集齐所有的卡片了吗？

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
Wow~ You bring light in my life again!
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
哇~你让我的生活重新有了希望！

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
Here are the gifts I promised... Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
这是我承诺的礼物...让我看看...

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
It's not much but please keep it! Haha, we still have lots of cards to be found. I hope you can help me tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
礼物虽然不多，还请收下！
哈哈，还有不少卡片没找到，希望你明天也能来帮忙。

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
Thank you!! I can continue working now. Nothing is impossible when we have great adventurers like you in this world!
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
谢谢你！！这下我可以继续工作了。
世界上有你这么出色的冒险者，什么困难都能解决！

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
ADIOS!
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
再见啦！

scripts.text: - Agent muttered something to himself. -
scripts.translation: - 特工自言自语地嘟囔着什么。 -

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
Mmmm~ not yet? We're short-handed... Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
嗯~还没好吗？人手不够啊...请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
I'm just saying that out of concern for you. You need TWO ^FF0000Blue 1 Card^000000. It's "2011"... Got it?
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
怕你弄错，特意提醒一下：需要两张^FF0000蓝色1卡片^000000。
要拼的是“2011”...明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
First, I will start attaching cards you found... I'll take the rest of cards tomorrow.
Please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
我先把你找到的卡片贴上...剩下的明天再收。
明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
Thanks for the last time.
I must keep on promoting the event so I want to ask you again~!
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
上次谢谢你了。
我必须继续宣传这个活动，所以想再拜托你一次~！

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
You've come again~
Thanks for the last time! We still have lots of cards to find. Could you help me out?
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
你又来啦~
上次谢谢你了！还有很多卡片没找到。能再帮我一次吗？

scripts.text: Ok!
scripts.translation: 好的！

scripts.text: I'm busy now.
scripts.translation: 我现在很忙

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
It's the same mission as before.
Try to gather blue cards and make the word, ^FF0000R W C 2 0 1 1 ^000000.
Good Luck!
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
任务和之前一样。
收集蓝色卡片，拼出^FF0000R W C 2 0 1 1 ^000000。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
...I see...
I still have lots of cards to find so if you have time, please come back and help again.
scripts.translation:
[RWC2011特工]
...我明白了...
我还有很多卡片没找到，如果你有空的话，请再回来帮我一次。

scripts.text:
[RWC2011 Agent]
... huh...?
I am... a new agent.
